_comment: EXP-1170: the NEW ISSUE page, identical x4 (web lib/issue-draft-page.ts, desktop domain::issue_draft, iOS ExpCore IssueDraftPage, Android domain/IssueDraftPage). There is no create dialog: every New issue opener mints a draft uuid and navigates to the issue detail IN DRAFT MODE, the same layout as the detail with only these differences: the identifier slot reads `header`, the trailing cluster is a primary `create` button and a close (`ui-close`) button whose tooltip/accessibility label is `discard` (EXP-1191: no one-item overflow menu), the body is title (placeholder `titlePlaceholder`, focused on open), property chips (status, priority, assignee, labels, due date, a board picker when the team has more than one board; no estimate), description (placeholder `descriptionPlaceholder`) and the draft's Files, nothing else. AUTOSAVE: one coalesced `issueDrafts.upsert` of the full row, `debounceMs` after the last title/description edit, at once on a chip change, on blur, on leaving the page and before Create; a title, description or attachment is content, chips alone never create a row; leaving an emptied existing draft deletes it. A draft with no title lists as `untitled`. EXP-1212: a draft WITH content (title, description or attachment) never goes silently. DISCARD (the close button) first asks `discardConfirm` (title, body, a destructive `confirm`, the platform's Cancel); a draft with no content discards at once. LEAVING the page any other way (back, a nav entry, opening another screen, closing its IDE tab) is HELD and asks `leave`: `create` (the page's Create, disabled without a title; the held navigation then continues instead of opening the new issue), `keep` (save, then continue) or `discard` (delete, then continue; no second confirmation); dismissing the dialog stays on the page. A draft with no content leaves silently and is deleted as before. Quitting the app or closing the browser tab is not held (the autosave keeps the draft). Details x4: while the file list of a reopened draft is not known yet it counts as content; nothing is asked while a Create is in flight; `keep` that fails to save stays on the page with the save error; a mode that never writes a draft row (a sub-issue or share compose on phones) offers `create` and `discard` only, no `keep`; the dialog never puts keyboard focus on `discard`. Wording and weight (Danny, 2026-10-05): each prompt is ONE question, the title; there is no body line. The leave dialog's default answer is `create` (primary, trailing, takes Enter and the initial focus; shown disabled without a title, then `keep` takes the focus), `keep` is the plain button beside it, `discard` a quiet destructive text button set apart on the leading edge; the buttons are the compact size in ONE row (they stack only when the row does not fit). The discard confirm is Cancel and a destructive `confirm`, same compact row. EXP-1231 CONCURRENCY: the same draft may be open on several clients (another tab, another device) at once; whichever client creates the issue or discards the draft consumes the row for all of them. The server stamps the created issue with the draft's id (`issues.draft_id`, synced) and refuses any later `issueDrafts.upsert` of a consumed id (CONFLICT), so no client can resurrect it. Every open page watches its row (`concurrency`): an issue carrying this draft id = CREATED ELSEWHERE, the page stops writing and replaces itself with that issue's detail at once, no prompt, no toast (its own Create does the same); a row that was synced and is gone with no such issue after `discardedGraceMs` = DISCARDED ELSEWHERE, the page stops writing, shows the `discardedElsewhere` toast and leaves (Back); a row that returns within the grace (a resync, this client's own racing write) resumes editing. Nothing is concluded while the page's own Create is in flight or after its own Create/Discard. A row this page has never seen synced is never 'gone'.

discardConfirm.title: Discard this draft and its files?

leave.title: Save this issue as a draft?
